Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that concludes the first day of cricketing action at the Commonwealth Games 2022! The action continues on Saturday, 30th of July as we will be back with another double-header. Firstly, New Zealand Women will take on South Africa Women at 3.30 pm IST (10 am GMT) and then it will be England Women going up against Sri Lanka Women at 10.30 pm IST (5 pm GMT). Our build-up for both the games will begin in advance. So do join us for the same. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Earlier in the day, courtesy of Hayley Matthews and Kycia Knight, Barbados women got to a very competitive score as they paced their knocks to perfection. Pakistan Women did bowl well, especially their spinners and had they batted with more intent in the first 10 overs, things could have been different. Pakistan Women need to get their batting order right as they have two big games coming up against India and Australia.

For Barbados, most of their bowlers had a good outing. The likes of Hayley, Shakera Selman and even Dottin did really well. Aaliyah Alleyne  and Shamilia Connell were good too but they took a beating towards the end. However, the damage done by them at the start meant they could afford to go for a few towards the end. Hayley Matthews was the star as along with bowling well, she was brilliant in the field as well and led from the front to take her side to an important victory here.

Pakistan Women just did not get off the blocks and also kept losing wickets. By the time they were in the final 10, the run rate needed was over 10. Nida Dar and Aliya Riaz initially had to save their wicket and take it deep but that saw the rate needed touching around 13. Dar though then stepped on the gas and she did get the Barbados team worried, however, she just did not get the support she wanted from Aliya and it was too much of an ask from her. Still though a top effort from Dar and maybe if the top order would have contributed, it could have been different.

That partnership between Aliya and Dar really got Barbados worrying but they held their nerve and came out on top in the end! Things though could have been so different had they got off to a better start. Sadly for Pakistan Women that was not the case and they have fallen short in the end.

OUT! CAUGHT! Hayley Matthews takes the catch and Barbados Women win this game by 15 runs! This is delivered at a shorter length on off. Ayesha Naseem makes room and looks to power it away. However, she gets the top edge and the ball goes in the air towards point. Hayley Matthews takes the catch and roars in delight as Barbados Women win their opening game of this tournament.
Commentary.Howout: c Hayley Matthews b Deandra Dottin

Commentary.Commentary: Bangs it short and around leg. Ayesha Naseem ducks under it.
Goes fuller on the pads. Dar flicks it to fine leg for a single.She gets to her fifty! It has been a fine knock but sadly it will not take her team over the line.
A fuller delivery on off. Ayesha Naseem hits it wide of mid off and takes a single.
SIX! Wow! A powerful shot from Ayesha Naseem! A fuller delivery on middle. Ayesha Naseem clears her front leg and tonks it over long on for a maximum.
WIDE! Drifts down the leg side again. Ayesha Naseem looks to flick it but misses.
On a length, on off. Dar hits it aerially and straight down the throat of long on. However, the fielder drops it and it is a single for Pakistan Women.
WIDE! Goes fuller and down the leg side. Dar looks to flick it but misses.

OUT! CAUGHT! This over has probably sealed the deal for Barbados Women! A length delivery on off. Riaz dances down the track and goes for a big heave. However, she only gets the bottom of her blade and the ball goes straight into the hands of Shamilia Connell at mid off. 27 needed now from last ball as Ayesha Naseem walks out to the middle.
Commentary.Howout: c Shamilia Connell b Aaliyah Alleyne

Commentary.Commentary: Goes fuller on off. Dar drives it to mid off and takes a single.
On a length, around off. Riaz pushes it to covers for a single.
Bangs it short and around leg. Dar looks to clip it away but the ball hits her pads and goes towards the leg side. A leg bye taken.
On a length, around off. Dar looks to cut it away but mistimes it.
Back of a length, around off. Riaz mistimes her cut shot to covers and takes a risky single. The bowler collects the throw and whips the bails off very late. Single completed.
Bangs it short, around off. Riaz tries to pull it. However, she gets a top edge that luckly for her falls in the vacant mid-wicket region. A single taken. 31 needed now from 12 balls!
On a length, on middle. Dar works it to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Nida Dar is playing a gem of an innings here! Back of a length, on leg. Dar pulls it fine and the ball races away towards the fence.
This is full and on the pads. Dar looks to flick it but misses. The ball hits her pads but it is going down leg.
This is fuller and outside off. Riaz slices it to deep point for a single.
A full delivery on off. Dar drills it to long on for a single.
A fuller delivery on middle. Dar whips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Dar gets a crucial boundary! Short and outside off. Dar cuts it through backward point for a boundary.
Back of a length, around off. Dar looks to cut it but misses.
WIDE! A fullish delivery and down the leg side. Dar looks to flick it but misses.
Back of a length, on off. Riaz pulls it to mid-wicket for a single.

In the air...but just short of long off. A length delivery on off. Riaz slogs it aerially towards long off. The fielder at long off runs forward and dives to catch it. The balls falls just short and two runs are taken again.
Back of a length, outside off. Riaz skips down the track and cuts it to deep point. She comes back for the second run.
A low full toss on leg. It is a slower delivery and Riaz looks to sweep it but misses. The batters run a leg bye as the ball rolls towards the leg side. 50 needed from 24 balls!
Dottin bowls a short ball angling into leg. Riaz makes room to cut it but misses.
Goes fuller on middle. Dar whips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! This is on the shorter side and down the leg side. Dar looks to clip it but misses.
On a length, around off. Riaz forces it to mid off and takes a quick single.
Back of a length, around off. Dar cuts it left of point. Hayley Matthews dives and stops it. Only single taken.
WIDE! Short and wide outside off. Dar leaves it alone and the umpire signals it as a wide.
On a length, on off. Riaz hits it to long on for a single.

SIX! This time over the fence and Dar is keeping Pakistan Women in this chase here! Shamilia Connell bowls it full on middle. Dar tonks it over long on for a maximum. 20 from the over and Pakistan Women need 57 now from 30 balls!
WIDE! Goes fuller and down the leg side. Dar looks to flick it but misses.
FOUR! Finds the gap again! Goes fuller and on the pads. Dar whips it off her pads and hits it towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
FOUR! Firmly hit this time! Shamilia Connell bangs it short again, This time it is at a comfortable height and Dar pulls it in front of square for a boundary.
WIDE! Shorter in length again and this time it is around leg. Dar looks to pull but misses.
Short and wide outside off. Dar looks to cut it but misses.
Nida Dar has been hit on the helmet and the physio is out now for the mandatory concussion test. She looks fine now and is ready to resume as Pakistan Women need 73 runs from 34 balls!
Bangs it short. It is a well-directed bouncer on middle and Dar looks to hook it away. She misses and the ball hits her helmet.
FOUR! Nida Dar picks up the boundary off the first ball of the over again! On a length, around off. Dar goes a bit across and swipes it towards the square leg fence for a boundary.
Another dot! 77 needed now from 36 balls! Back of a length and outside off. Riaz looks to cut it but misses.
Goes fuller on off. Riaz drives but finds the fielder at mid on.
Back of a length, around off. Riaz punches it to covers.
Shorter and outside off. Riaz cuts it to deep point for a couple.
Back of a length, around off. Dar punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! Nida Dar has the ability to find the boundaries and Pakistan need her to bat till the end. This is a low full toss on the pads. Dar flicks it through the square leg region for a boundary.
Yet another dot! Fired outside off, Riaz plays it to covers.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Around off, this is pushed to covers.
On off, this is hit through covers for one.

NOT OUT! The keeper lost the ball while she tried to take the bails off! Two more! On middle, this is swept through square leg for a couple as there is a fumble. The throw comes in to the keeper who seems to have taken the bails off. It is taken upstairs. Replays show that she did not have the ball in hand.
FOUR! Need more of these! Fuller and outside off, this is smashed through covers for a boundary.
Finds the fielder! Shorter and outside off, this is driven square but to point.
Good shot but only one! Outside off, this is lofted over covers for one.
Fuller and outside off, this is hit through covers for one.
Just the one! Singles are not going to do it! On off, this is played towards cover for one.

Direct hit and Aliya was a goner! On the pads, Aliya looks to flick but misses, it hits the pad and rolls on the off side. They go for a run. Dottin picks the ball up from point and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Full and on the pads, Dar looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. A leg bye taken.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
On middle, defended.
Aliya Riaz walks out to the middle.

OUT! RUN OUT! This is the last thing one team would want when they are so behind in the game. However, Bismah Maroof wasn't playing the role Pakistan wanted her to do out there. She was playing far too many dots and this wicket could well be a blessing in disguise for Pakistan. On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket. Maroof is off. The fielder dives to her right and stops it. Dar sends her back from the point of no return. The fielder throws it to Hayley Matthews who fires it to the keeper and she does the rest.
Leading edge but safe! On middle, Maroof comes down the track and looks to flick but she gets a leading edge which lands well short of the bowler.
Around off, Maroof looks to play the reverse sweep but misses and gets hit high on the body.
On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
On a length, around off. Bismah Maroof only manages to punch it towards cover-point. 97 needed now from 60 balls!
WIDE! Bismah Maroof goes across to the off side and Shakera Selman bowls it wider outside off again. Bismah Maroof does not get a bat on it as she looks to guide it away and the umpire calls it wide.
WIDE! Goes fuller and wider outside off. Bismah Maroof leaves it alone.
FOUR! Much-needed boundary! A fullish delivery on off. Bismah Maroof just lifts it over mid on for a boundary. They needed much more of these boundaries.
Serves a length delivery, around off. Bismah Maroof skips down the track and pushes it to covers.
On a length and outside off. Bismah Maroof looks to cut it but misses.
This is full and wider outside off. It is way too wide and Bismah Maroof goes chasing for it but misses.
Drifting on the pads. Dar works it wide of short fine leg for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Bismah Maroof drives it to mid off.
A flatter delivery on middle. Bismah Maroof works it towards the leg side.
Slower through the air, on off. Bismah Maroof drives it to covers and the fielder there half-stops it. Bismah Maroof wants a single but Dar is not interested.
Flighted delivery, around off. Dar looks to drive but misses. The ball hit the keeper's pads and deflects towards short fine leg. A bye taken.

OUT! KNOCKED HER OVER! Hayley Matthews is in the action again, this time with the ball! A fuller delivery on off from 'round the wicket. Muneeba Ali dances down the track and goes for a big heave across the line but misses. The ball shatters the stumps and Pakistan Women are in trouble here as Muneeba Ali departs while trying to up the ante. Nida Dar is the next batter in.
Tossed up, around off. Bismah Maroof skips down the track and hits it to long off for a single.
On a length, on off. Ali drags it to mid on. Dot ball to end the over and 106 needed now from 72 balls!
Fuller length and around off. Bismah Maroof drives but gets a thick outside edge to third man for a single.
Well bowled! Shakera Selman bowls it very full and wider outside off. Bismah Maroof tries to reach it but lets it go in the end.
Goes fuller and outside off. Ali drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
A short delivery on off. Ali pulls it to the mid-wicket fielder.
This is full and outside off. Ali makes room and goes chasing for it but misses.
Tossed up on middle. Ali goes for the big slog-sweep. However, she gets a top edge of her blade and the ball falls short of the deep mid-wicket fielder running to her right. A single in the end.
Tad shorter and around off. Bismah Maroof punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Keeps it full, on off. Ali drives it right of the bowler. Hayley Matthews dives but just half-stops it as the ball deflects towards long off. A single taken.
Full again and bit wider outside off. Ali drives it to the cover fielder in the ring.
Goes fuller, around off. Bismah Maroof drives it to long off for a single.
A full toss on off. Bismah Maroof drives it back to the bowler.
On off, this is pushed to mid off.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
On off, this is pushed towards cover and a single is taken.

FOUR! That is played nicely. Takes full toll of the Free Hit! On the pads, this is swept through square leg, no one in the deep and it is another boundary. Not sure why the Windies are bowling it on the pads.
NO BALL AND FOUR! That surely has slipped! A high full toss, this is pulled over the mid-wicket fielder and it races away to the fence.
On middle, this is pushed to mid on.
Around off, this is guided to point for one.

Confusion but no harm done in the end! On a length and around off, this is guided towards point. The fielder dives to her right and stops it. The non-striker is off but is sent back from mid-way through.
Shorter and outside off, Muneeba Ali slashes at it but is beaten by the extra bounce.
Another one on a length and around off, Ali guides it to point.
This time she gets it through the gap in the point region but just the one. Pakistan need to get a move on now.
Another one on a length and around off, this is guided to point.
Good length and on off, Maroof plays it to point.
Drop and run! That though is a fine over from Aaliyah Alleyne! On off, this is played towards point for one.
Yet another dot! Outside off, on the shorter side. Maroof cuts but to point.
Well outside off, Maroof slashes but misses.
That was quick work from Dottin! Around off, this is guided to point. The non-striker takes off but is sent back in time.
WIDE! That is really wide outside off, left alone.
Outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.
That is a sharp bumper, Maroof looks to pull but this one skids through, it hits the splice and rolls on the leg side.
On a length, on off. Bismah Maroof blocks it out.

OUT! RUN OUT! Omaima Sohail is run out but not before some great drama! Shamilia Connell bowls it just short of good length and the ball drifts on the leg stump. Omaima Sohail looks to clip it away but misses. The ball hits her pads and there is an appeal for an LBW initially. The umpire though is not interested. The ball deflects off her pads towards backward point and Omaima Sohail bit unaware of that is out of her crease. Hayley Matthews picks the ball and fires a direct hit at the batter's end. There is an appeal for a run out as well after that. In the meanwhile the batters steal a leg bye. However, Hayley Matthews reviews! The umpire first check for the LBW but  the Ball Tracking shows that the ball is missing leg. However, she is found out of her crease as the umpire checks for an LBW. The Barbados Women start celebrating and Omaima Sohail starts walking off. The TV screen though shows NOT OUT first but then shows OUT! Omaima Sohail walks off finally off the field and Barbados Women get a second wicket! Let's just dive deeper into this wicket, Hayley Matthews actually did not wanted a review for an LBW as she knew that the batter was run out. However, the umpire denies her appeal and Barbados Women end up losing their review.

A run out appeal and it is taken upstairs! A lot of confusion. Pakistan kept running after the direct hit as Windies were celebrating and the umpire had not signaled anything. Actually, it is a review taken too for an LBW.
FOUR! Powerful pull shot this time! Bangs it short on off. Omaima Sohail pulls it through the square leg region for a boundary.
Shorter in length and outside off. Omaima Sohail gets beaten again as she looks to cut it.
Lovely delivery! Lands on a good length and it is outside off. Omaima Sohail looks to punch it away but misses.
Lands on a length, on off. Omaima Sohail defends it towards the off side.
FOUR! Full toss and punished! On middle and Ali hammers it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Ohh...dropped! A full delivery on off. Ali drives it right of the bowler. However, she does so uppishly and it is quite a comfortable chace for Shanika Bruce. However, she drops it.
Drifting on the pads. Omaima Sohail works it wide of short fine leg for a single.
Goes fuller and outside off. Omaima Sohail drives it to cover-point.

WIDE! This is full and down the leg side. Omaima Sohail looks to flick it but misses. The umpire calls it wide but there is a stumping appeal. The replays roll in and it shows that Omaima Sohail is safe here.
Serves a fullish delivery on off. Omaima Sohail blocks it out.
FOUR! Nicely played! This is full and outside off. Omaima Sohail drives it through cover-point for a boundary.
On a length, around off. Omaima Sohail pushes it to covers for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Omaima Sohail pushes it to point and looks for a single then decides to avoid a run. There is a direct hit at the bowler's end but Ali is well inside her crease.
This is wider outside off. Again good swing on offer and Omaima Sohail leaves it.
On a good length and pitched around off. It swings away and Omaima Sohail leaves it.
A fullish delivery, on off. Omaima Sohail drives it to covers.
WIDE! Good away movement this time but it is wider outside off. Omaima Sohail leaves it.
Back of a length, around off. Omaima Sohail looks to push it away but gets beaten.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Dream start for Barbados Women! Shamilia Connell bowls it a bit short and outside off. Iram Javed with a nothing shot here. She just pushes for it away from her body. The ball catches the outside edge of her blade and Kycia Knight takes an easy catch behind the stumps. Omaima Sohail walks out at number 3!
Commentary.Howout: c Kycia Knight b Shamilia Connell
